Descriptions

This beautiful upholstered platform bed features a padded headboard that gives your bedroom a modern, chic look and is filled with thick foam for added comfort. Sturdy timber frame construction and a wooden slatted system for added stability and safety. A hydraulic storage system under the mattress makes it possible to store your bedroom essentials in a smaller space without compromising the desired bed size. In addition, this product comes with a slat kit. Don't miss the chance to take it home today.
